title: Minimal Sufficient Predictive Information for Time-Aware Synthetic Control in Gaussian State-Space Panels
banked_reason: D0.5.G graded the delivered package incremental with paper-score ceiling 5.9 below the field floor 7.4 and found no bounded in-scope repair; three local panel findings remain unrepaired.
proof_attempt_summary: Discovery derived the direct TASC counterexample, full- and singular-support equality criteria, an unrestricted donor-adjusted predictive quotient, and boundary-aware inference ingredients. D0.5 nevertheless capped the delivered package at incremental because certified magnitude projection and a useful eligible application were absent, while the exact-test rank condition, provenance, and computation-scope findings remained unrepaired. The proposed projection/application lift was independently judged an unbounded, data-dependent research program rather than a bounded route to the field floor.
tldr: For a fixed untreated Gaussian panel window and declared ordered donor-post information, the paper gives a unified correction of Rho et al.'s Proposition A.1(1)--(3): the full Kalman pair can be sufficient without being minimal, sigma-field inclusion gives weak rather than automatic strict information or MSE dominance, and the replacement is the coarsest target- and donor-adjusted predictive sigma-field. It derives full- and singular-support equality frontiers, exact density-weighted computation for \(L\le4\), an exact iid-window equality test, and an ideal boundary-valid projected interval. The application uses the dimensionless gain \(\Delta/R_{\mathrm{bag}}\), but certified nonvacuous endpoint computation and a useful-width untreated application remain open, and predictive gain is not ATT identification.
gap: RhoEtAl2026TASC, arXiv:2601.03099v1, Appendix A, Proposition A.1(2), establishes only weak dominance from sigma-field inclusion but claims strictness from nonzero latent dynamics without observability, target relevance, or an equality analysis. Existing Gaussian, invariance, predictive-state, and boundary-inference results supply ingredients but not the combined target/horizon/donor-post characterization or a calibrated gain diagnostic.
fill: Establish the exact full- and singular-support frontiers, connect them to the minimal donor-adjusted predictive quotient, implement exact small-window orbit evaluation, and provide inference valid at zero gain. Treat certified general magnitude projection as an explicit open obligation and evaluate application precision against a fixed relative-loss rule: ten-percent minimum MSE gain, five-percentage-point maximum interval width, and endpoint-based meaningful, negligible, or inconclusive categories.
